item.title: AI Root Cause Analysis Shifts from Model Reasoning to Context Engineering
item.description:
Engineers are increasingly arguing that modern LLMs can already reason through root cause analysis once given correctly prepared context, shifting the hard problem to the pipelines that correlate telemetry. A Coroot experiment across eleven models offers early evidence for the claim.

By Mark Silvester

item.title: How Zalando Built an In-Process Client-Side Load Balancer for One Million Requests per Second
item.description:
The engineering team at Zalando recently described the design and implementation of an in-process, client-side load balancer for a high-throughput API handling around 1 million requests per second. The result was more predictable latency, a drop in infrastructure costs, and better visibility into where failures actually originate.

By Renato Losio
